description: A calm-coding marketplace of Claude Code plugins and skills.
name: pardes

plugins.description: Foundational plugin — shared hooks and core skills.
plugins.name: base

plugins.description: Get oriented in the marketplace and tune your setup — explains what each plugin does and how they compose, then runs an advisory config doctor that reports recommended settings and applies them only with your explicit confirmation.
plugins.name: onboarding

plugins.description: Plan a large multi-chunk PR through a user interview, then ship it by dispatching focused sub-agents one chunk at a time.
plugins.name: orchestrate

plugins.description: Install the whole marketplace at once — a meta plugin with no skills of its own that depends on every other pardes plugin, so a single install pulls them all in (auto-install + auto-enable requires Claude Code v2.1.143+).
plugins.name: pardes-all

plugins.description: Write a clear, useful PR description — a tight Why / How / Decisions / Callouts structure with no filler.
plugins.name: pr-description

plugins.description: Reusable, dependency-free orchestration shell helpers — freshen a checkout to a clean baseline, prune merged branches, and reap stale worktrees. Available as PATH commands and sourceable shell functions.
plugins.name: shell-helpers

plugins.description: Run as the autonomous shift leader of a multi-PR / multi-agent effort — maximize progress, reach the away user only via AskUserQuestion, gate phases on PR merges (never merge yourself), and dispatch file-disjoint parallel worktree agents at high velocity.
plugins.name: shift-leader

plugins.description: A rich, multi-line status line for Claude Code — model, context-pressure bar, cost, git, PR, and rate limits on the main line, plus per-subagent gauges in the agent panel.
plugins.name: statusline
